title: Campus Bikes II
description:
There are workers and bikes at distinct integer coordinates. Assign one bike to each worker, with each bike used at most once. The cost of an assignment is the sum of Manhattan distances from workers to their assigned bikes. Return the minimum possible cost.

## Examples

```text
Input: workers = [[0, 0], [2, 1]], bikes = [[1, 2], [3, 3]]
Output: 6
```

```text
Input: workers = [[0, 0], [1, 0], [2, 0]], bikes = [[0, 1], [2, 1], [3, 0], [3, 1]]
Output: 4
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= workers.length <= bikes.length <= 10`
- Each coordinate is in `[0, 999]`.
- Worker locations are distinct, and bike locations are distinct.
